adjacency_disclosed: RD-003 Stage-2 vol_regime_switch = donchian/z-score switch at 4h/1d (different mechanism, timeframes; RD-004 is pure trend and adds SCALE). RD-002 judged ungated donchian/ts-momentum; RD-004's claim is the marginal value of the regime treatment vs its own in-grid ungated baselines.

costs.model: rd2/costs2.py CRYPTO: taker 5 bps/side + 3 bps/side spread+slippage = 16 bps round trip
costs.sensitivity: 2x costs (32 bps RT) on every cell

data.contract: harness data_feed cache: per-zip SHA-256, canonical CSV SHA-256, gap audit; gaps reported, never filled

derived.2h: resampled from verified 15m, complete buckets only, parent csv_sha256 recorded (rd4-local resample following the harness rule; harness _TF_MINUTES has no 2h entry)

data.months: 2023-01..2026-10 (per-symbol first available archive month for post-2023 listings)
data.source: Binance Vision USDT-M futures monthly klines (data.binance.vision)

exits.anchor: entry price, ATR(14) at signal bar (fastsim convention); scale mode multiplies both multiples by f
exits.convention: entry at next bar open; entry bar exit-checked; stop first; gap-through at open; one position per symbol

judgement.bar: expectancy > 0 AND PF >= 1.2 AND >= 200 OOS trades AND >= 80% folds positive AND stats2.holdout2 pass AND significance at running N (Bonferroni p < 0.05/N AND deflated Sharpe >= 0.95) AND 2x-cost PF >= 1.2 with expectancy > 0
judgement.folds: W1-W5 STANDARD (OOS 2024-07-01..2026-11-01), trades attributed by entry time, pooled over CRYPTO30

verdicts.WATCHLIST: mechanical bar + holdout pass, significance or 2x-cost failed

mechanism: Trend persistence in crypto is regime-dependent: Donchian/EMA-cross entries gated or bracket-scaled by a daily ATR%-percentile regime state, at 15m/2h timeframes not judged for trend families by RD-002/RD-003.

modes.scale: always enter; bracket multiples scaled by f = 0.75 + 0.5*R(d)

regime.daily_vol: V(d) = mean of bar ATR% over UTC day d
regime.rank: R(d) = #{k in [d-180, d-1] : V(k) <= V(d-1)} / 180; all bars of day d use R(d); first usable day needs 181 days of history

sanity_anchor.cell: ts_momentum roc42_4h on BTC/ETH/SOL (1h 2023-10..2026-10 resampled to 4h, families2 chain, BR24)

signals.don20: close crosses above prior-20-bar high (long) / below prior-20-bar low (short); channel excludes current bar

title: Volatility-regime trend following (CRYPTO30, 15m + 2h)
